shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -la && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md && git show --stat HEAD | head -50

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html src/*.tsx src/index.css .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -n -A8 '"version"\|peerDependencies' | head -30 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Card Text ThemeProvider Flex
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Card Text ThemeProvider Flex; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; grep -n -i -A25 'required setup\|## Install\|## Usage' README.md | head -90

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && sed -n 120,400p INDEX.md | grep -n -i 'provider\|textinput\|password\|checkbox\|button\b\|\[button\|card\|\[text\]\|flex\|form\|label\|alert' | head -40; grep -n -i -B2 -A20 'provider' guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -80

wc -l components/controls/TextInput.md components/controls/PasswordInput.md components/Checkbox.md components/Button.md components/Card.md components/Text.md; grep -n -i -A12 'error\|validation' guides/migration-to-v8.md | grep -i -A12 'input' | head -50; ls components | grep -i provider; ls guides
cat components/controls/TextInput.md components/controls/PasswordInput.md components/Checkbox.md components/Card.md components/Text.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; grep -n -i -A6 'view=\|width\|loading\|type=\|## Properties\|## Props' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md | head -90

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && sed -n '/## Properties/,/## CSS/p' components/Button.md | head -40; grep -n -C3 'direction\|gap=' guides/layout.md | head -60; grep -n -A20 '^## Flex\|Shortcut\|shortcut' guides/migration-layout-v8.md | head -60
sed -n 28,80p guides/migration-layout-v8.md; grep -n -i '`as`\|as=\|maxWidth\|width=' guides/layout.md | head; grep -n -i 'lang\|Provider' guides/i18n.md | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && sed -n '/## Properties/,$p' build/docs/components/Alert.md | head -30; grep -n 'spacing-' build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -8; find build/esm/components/Card build/esm/components/Text -name '*.d.ts' | head;
cat build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -60; grep -n 'as\b\|Props' build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -20

grep -o 'padding[^;]*\|max-width[^;]*\|box-sizing[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css | sort | uniq -c; grep -o 'margin[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/*.css 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/
